validated_behaviour: Body AOI performs ray–body intersection at each gaze sample timestamp.
Self/partner C3D is interpolated independently of the approximately 30 FPS video clock.
Video frames are used only for overlay, frame summaries and human-review navigation.
FaceMapper remains video-frame observation evidence; safe same-track geometry is estimated at gaze timestamps.
Exact observed FaceMapper frames are not mislabeled as interpolated evidence.
v0.21.51 and earlier Body AOI artifacts are blocked from review/fusion until regenerated.
Raw Vicon full-body 10-finger marker aliases build direct torso and pelvis geometry.
limitations: The user-provided raw S001_I01_R01 C3D was tested; the corresponding R02 raw C3D was not available in this environment.
The full private S001 OculoStudio project, its gaze-ray artifact and FaceMapper artifact were not available for a complete project-level rerun.

A generic legacy AOI Review browser test was attempted twice but Chromium refused its random loopback URL with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR. Three other live Chromium suites for geometry gating, Body human review and persistent Human Review entry passed with no page or console errors.
Windows batch files were inspected and the bundled wheel was installed in a clean Linux target; an actual Windows installation must run on the user machine.
